import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    B = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    heap = []
    balance = 0
    for i in range(n):
        balance += 1 if arr[i] % 2 == 0 else -1
        if balance == 0 and i < n - 1:
            heapq.heappush(heap, abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))

    cuts = 0
    while heap and B >= heap[0]:
        B -= heapq.heappop(heap)
        cuts += 1

    print(cuts)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
